messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — I put together a pre-launch SEO checklist for the webinar landing + launch blog. Can folks skim and flag anything missing? doc: https://docs.google.com/some-long-link :eyes:

james: grabbing it now. high-level: we need 1) keyword intent buckets 2) canonical + hreflang (if needed) 3) schema JSON-LD for webinar + speaker 4) redirect map for old URLs.

olivia: note on schema — we'll want both Event and FAQ on the landing. I'll draft a minimal JSON-LD we can paste. Also CTA markup so registration button is visible to crawlers.

leo: for internal linking, recommend 3 inbound anchors from product docs + 2 from blog posts. I'll map anchors -> target in a CSV. keep anchor text varied (brand + intent).

sara: redirect heads-up: one legacy webinar page at /resources/old-webinar -> /webinar/launch-2026. I can push a small mod to the rewrite table. Question: do we want to keep query params for utm tracking? usually we canonicalize without them.

james: keywords draft (intent grouped):
- transactional: "start hosted llm api", "redwood inference pricing"
- informational: "llm inference latency optimization", "model serving best practices"
- navigational: "Redwood webinar 2026", "Redwood inference docs"
We should use long-tail + webinar-specific phrases in H1/H2 and meta description.

olivia: JSON-LD snippet (minimal) — paste into head. replace placeholders.
```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Event",
  "name": "Redwood Inference: Launch + Benchmarks Webinar",
  "startDate": "2026-04-15T16:00:00Z",
  "endDate": "2026-04-15T17:00:00Z",
  "location": {"@type": "VirtualLocation", "url": "https://redwood.ai/webinar"},
  "organizer": {"@type": "Organization", "name": "Redwood Inference"},
  "performer": [{"@type": "Person", "name": "Avery Chen"}],
  "description": "Live demo and benchmark narrative — production-focused inference patterns."
}
```

leo: internal link plan example (CSV rows):
`source_path,anchor_text,target_path`
`/blog/production-llm,production inference patterns,/webinar/launch-2026`
`/docs/serving-runtime,low-latency inference,/webinar/launch-2026`
I'll drop full CSV in the doc.

sara: redirect rule (Netlify/NGINX style):
```
# keep utm, but canonicalize other params:
rewrite ^/resources/old-webinar$ /webinar/launch-2026 permanent;
# or for next.js i18n edge: { source: '/resources/old-webinar', destination: '/webinar/launch-2026', permanent: true }
```

maria: perfect. one more ask — can we add tracking/testing hooks for performance keywords? want to attach a small eval set to Redwood Optimize so we can watch quality regressions post-launch.

james: yes — I'll create a keyword SERP tracking list + a prompt/eval set for the launch queries. planning to run baseline this week.

deploy-bot: Reminder: Landing page publish scheduled for 2026-04-10 09:00 UTC. Run SEO checklist 24h prior. :white_check_mark:

maria: action items: james -> keyword list + SERP tracking, olivia -> final JSON-LD + FAQ schema, leo -> internal link CSV, sara -> redirect PR + verification steps. I'll update the doc and tag triage owner fields. Thanks all :zap:
